summary: For Kiribati, restoration is the only commitment type represented. The revised NDC gives a mangrove-enhancement sink estimate of 0.15 ktCO2, also stated as ktCO2e, in 2030, replacing an earlier 7.1 ktCO2 INDC estimate that the passage calls erroneous. A further passage gives 0.16 ktCO2e sequestration in 2025 and also repeats 0.15 ktCO2 for 2025, creating a timing inconsistency with the 2030 statement. The conditional AFOLU action is to plant 7 ha of mangrove forest, with no year specified. For scale, 7 ha is about 0.8% of the country's reported 9 km² forest class and about 0.007% of its 950 km² total area. The extracted pledges quantify restoration outcomes and planting area; no numerical conservation or agriculture targets are provided.

targets.context: The same numerical 0.15 target is also reported with the unit label ktCO2e; the duplicate is merged.
